3/27/26 10:00 AM Update: Chair 6 and Southback are now open!
Good morning Shredders! Today continues our warm and sunny spring skiing streak. Snow will start off slightly firm but will return to everyone’s favorite soft and playfull corn snow pretty quickly. Make sure you bring sunscreen and some dark sunglasses/goggles! It will be bright! Chair 6 will likely open after evaluation this morning.  Be sure to stop by the Plaza at 11am for Avy Dog Day, and check out all our Uphill Wknd Events going on in the next few days! 
 
Kelly's gap, Northway, Lower Ferks, Deerfly, Exterminator are closed the season. Please do not duck the ropes they are there for a reason.
 
Terrain Parks: Discovery Park, Sudden Drop and Arwine's Jump Line are all open today.
 
Events: 
  • Bikini Downhill-April 11: The galaxy’s most outrageous springtime tradition is back. Across the snowy expanse of Crystal Mountain, brave spring skiers and riders will unite to defy the cold and embrace the sunshine in a race like no other. 1st place winners take home a 26/27 Ikon Pass, registration is open!
  • Pond Skim-April 18: Grab a cold one and catch all of the action as passionate skiers and snowboarders brave the Cascade chill of the pond skim waters and try to impress our judges with their best skim, costume, and splash in hopes of winning a 26/27 Ikon Pass.
  • Mt.Rainier Berm Brawl Banked Slalom April 25 +26: Get ready to drop into the Mt. Rainier Berm Brawl for a one-of-a-kind banked slalom at Crystal Mountain. This all-ages snowboard event is packed with high-speed action, sick prizes, and good vibes on the slopes. Whether you're racing for the podium or just here for the party, it's time to carve into spring and send it. Register today!
Notes for today: 
  1. $199 Spring 3-Day Passes are on sale now! Ski for just $67 a day, any day of the week, for the rest of the season!  
  2. This weekend, March 28th-29th, will be the last weekend Parking Reservations are required. The last day for the Crystal Express Shuttle service will be Sunday March 29th.  
  3. Looking to save time and make the most of the day? Consider grabbing a Daily Reserve Upgrade! Available on weekends and holidays, this upgrade grants access to priority lift access, getting you on the lift quicker and fresh tracks faster.  
  4. Don't forget to check out Crystal Mountain Outfitters for their Spring Sale going on right now! Save up to 50% on all 25-26 winter items. (Some exclusions may apply) 
  5. Swing by Brand X and check out all this year's demos for sale at a great price! 
  6. Did you know it just takes 5 Days to be entered to win a 26/27 Ikon Pass? Track your days on the Ikon App and register for RIDE TO WIN 
  7. Paid reservations can only be cancelled by emailing SP+ at  CrystalMtnParking@spplus.com with Reservation #, First Name, and Last Name. While you may not receive an immediate reply, the cancellation will be processed. The Crystal Mountain Contact Center cannot process these cancellations. 
  8. Parking refunds for guests who paid for parking reservations March 14 & 15 are expected to be completed through SP+ by March 31st. No email is necessary.   
  9. In case of on-mountain emergency: Call 360-663-3064 or 911 
 
Mountain Weather 3/26/2026 4:20pm  

Forecaster: Chris Pleasance 
 
Synopsis: Throw on your spring fit—it's time to harvest some corn. Mild air is seeping into the region as a weak upper-level ridge nestles over the Cascades, strengthening through this evening. A calm, clear night will deliver a solid overnight freeze, setting the stage for a classic diurnal cycle on Friday. The morning starts chilly, but that powerful March sun will start putting in work the moment it hits the slopes. With light winds offering little cooling relief, expect corn o’clock before noon! Fortunately, temps look to stay reasonable enough to keep the snow from getting too sloppy, making Friday a prime day for spring laps.

Extended: Saturday looks to be the nicest day of the weekend with the last bit of our ridge hanging on before a new trough sags southward into the PNW. Temps won’t be quite as warm on Saturday, but mostly sunny skies and light winds should still make for soft spring turns. Sunday starts to flip the script as we welcome a weak low pressure system into our region. This pattern change should provide lower freezing levels and a couple inches of snow, if we’re lucky.  
 
*Daily Summaries: 12hr period representing 4am-4pm or 4pm-4am data 
*Freezing Elevation (ft): Approximate elevation above sea level where the air temperature reaches 32 degree F
